policy: Optional local-world events for sandbox play. Every event is original, non-canon, player-optional, and must be selected only when its conditions are met.

events.title: A Crate in the Current
conditions: player is near a navigable coast
choices: Return the crate to its marked owner
Use the supplies to help a nearby settlement
effects: A trade contact may be discovered
Settlement trust and supply can change
events.fail_forward: If ignored, the crate washes ashore and becomes a rumor lead.

events.title: Trouble at the Docks
choices: Leave the workers to settle it
effects: Faction tension and local trust may change
A temporary port service may become unavailable
events.fail_forward: The dispute cools down over time, but one side may remember the player's choice.

events.title: A Weathered Log Pose
conditions: player has access to a ship
effects: May reveal a safe detour or a supply stop; never overrides required navigation
events.fail_forward: The device gives no reliable reading, but its previous owner becomes a contact.

events.title: A Traveling Medic
conditions: player has a crew member needing recovery or a settlement has low trust
effects: Recovery support or a medical contact; costs and trust depend on choice
events.fail_forward: The medic leaves after offering basic first aid and a location rumor.

events.title: The Wrong Face on the Poster
conditions: player has visited a populated port
choices: Use the confusion to misdirect a pursuer
effects: Local reputation or security pressure may change
events.fail_forward: The poster remains for a while, creating a small social complication rather than a forced fight.

events.title: A Night-Market Shortage
choices: Buy scarce goods at the posted price
effects: Market supply, trust, and prices may change locally
events.fail_forward: The shortage eases slowly; prices remain elevated for a short period.

events.title: Sails in Distress
choices: Keep distance and mark the location
effects: May create a rival, ally, or future rescue lead based on conduct
events.fail_forward: The vessel escapes or is lost off-screen; no canon character is involved.

events.title: A Festival Needs Hands
conditions: a local festival flag is active
choices: Enjoy the festival without taking a task
effects: Small reputation gains, local contacts, and optional minigame entry
events.fail_forward: The festival proceeds without the player; a contact may still remember their visit.

events.title: The Missing Ferry
conditions: player has visited a coastal settlement
effects: May open a local rescue quest or reveal a smuggling clue
events.fail_forward: The ferry returns late or is found damaged; the route remains usable with delay.

events.title: The Scrap Merchant's Offer
conditions: player has access to a port or workshop
effects: May unlock ship repair materials or a local dispute
events.fail_forward: The merchant moves on; the player keeps any public evidence gathered.
